subject: Default Number of Quadrature Points for MultipleGroup Function

messages.author: 59848f250ed4238a
messages.subject: Default Number of Quadrature Points for MultipleGroup Function
parts:
Good Evening, Dr. Chalmers,

I am using the MultipleGroup function in the MIRT package to test for DIF using a unidimensional scale. If quadpts = 'Null', what is the number of quadrature points used? 

Thanks in advance,
Quintin

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Default Number of Quadrature Points for MultipleGroup Function
parts:
Hi Quintin,

The default for unidimensional models is to use 41. Most of the details in the estimation can be found in the ?mirt help file (this goes for mirt(), mixedmirt(), bfactor(), and multipleGroup() too). Cheers.

Phil
